Mx A v Acme Ltd — Reserved Judgment

Case number
2200001/2024
Decision date
12 April 2024
Jurisdiction code
Unfair Dismissal
Country
England and Wales
Decision
The claim is well-founded and the claimant was unfairly dismissed.

Reasons

The claimant was dismissed for alleged misconduct on 7 January 2024. The tribunal considered the test under section 98 of the Employment Rights Act 1996 and the band of reasonable responses applicable to the conduct ground. The respondent's investigation was inadequate and no genuine appeal hearing was offered. We find the dismissal was unfair within the meaning of ERA 1996.

The claimant has provided contact details for correspondence: email claimant@example.com, phone 07700 900 123, postcode N1 1AA, NI AB 12 34 56 C.

We consider a Polkey deduction of 25% appropriate to reflect the likelihood of a fair dismissal had a proper procedure been followed.
